_doc: Live animated overlay patches drawn on the Brain final boss by BrainBoss.Draw. texCenter/texW/texH are in brainbosshd texture pixels; the game pins the on-screen footprint to that crop so patches pulse with the boss. triggerAvgSeconds (optional) makes a patch rest on frame 0 and play one cycle every ~N seconds instead of looping. interpolate:false (optional) draws the nearest frame with no cross-fade shader. Built by tools/brainanim/build_brain_overlays.py; don't hand-edit.
